reviewScope: Internal engineering, model-consistency and browser-viewport review; not independent expert certification, official curriculum mapping, physical-device/FPS/printer or calibrated laboratory validation. Native drag remains unverified while Mac locked; verified accessible camera buttons provide working orbit/tilt/zoom. Ideal sand retention, no spills, fixed post-drain mother-water hold-up, perfectly mixed fresh washes, nonvolatile reference salt and prescribed transfers/dry endpoints. No adsorption, salt co-evaporation, measured filter resistance, heat transfer, dissolution/drying kinetics or real purity guarantee. Zero retention is an ideal limit; positive hold-up with finite washing leaves salt with dry sand. Rounded capacity.36g/g, apparent dissolved volume.3mL/g and packing.6 are reference assumptions; porous bands include solid, liquid and air, not pure solid volume. Editorial class placement; quantitative recovery is a teacher extension.
